is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report any new genotype data for insecticide-resistance markers. It only mentions that the field population was 'previously characterized' by kdr allele frequencies in other studies (page 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported for the mosquitoes used in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-collected Anopheles arabiensis from Asendabo, Oromia Region, Ethiopia.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study evaluating insecticide toxicity.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new bioassay experiments on field-collected mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is reported in the paper or its supplements.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the toxicity of clothianidin and chlorfenapyr against a laboratory strain and a field-collected population of Anopheles arabiensis from Ethiopia using WHO and CDC bottle bioassays. It does not perform or report any new molecular genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers.
